Rationale: Readable, consistent, easy to query and map to product objects/actions.
Application / Control: Apply consistently across Event Tracking Plan, Developer Handoff and downstream event models.

Convention: Unique event_id per emitted event; immutable transaction IDs for financial/business transactions.
Rationale: Supports deduplication, lineage and auditability without suppressing valid repeat behaviour.
Application / Control: Event ID for telemetry; transaction-specific idempotency key for transactional outcomes.

Convention: UTC ISO-8601 event timestamps; preserve event time and ingestion time separately.
Rationale: Enables consistent ordering and latency analysis across clients and services.
Application / Control: Validate timestamp format/timezone; retain event_timestamp and ingested_at.

Convention: Stable user_id as cross-domain join key; entity-specific primary keys for facts.
Rationale: Avoids ambiguous joins and supports one-to-many lifecycle histories.
Application / Control: Do not use email/name as analytical join keys.

Convention: Use approved enumerated lifecycle states; do not invent production status codes.
Rationale: Prevents inconsistent grouping and false transitions.
Application / Control: New status values require product/engineering approval and schema versioning.

Convention: Keep amount and unit separate; do not sum unlike reward units without approved conversion rules.
Rationale: Prevents invalid aggregation of VEs, XP, Gems, Tokens or other units.
Application / Control: Finance/Product must approve unit conversion and accounting treatment.

Convention: Distinguish Observed/Confirmed, Proposed and To Be Verified; label simulated records explicitly.
Rationale: Prevents assumptions from being mistaken for production facts.
Application / Control: Carry evidence status into dictionary, KPI catalogue, event plan and reports.

Convention: Capture provider/source references and provider outcome separately where applicable.
Rationale: VELOOP may not control ad, survey, offer, game or third-party tracking outcomes.
Application / Control: Reconcile provider callbacks and backend validation before reward credit.

Convention: Use pseudonymous IDs in analytical models; exclude secrets and minimise direct identifiers.
Rationale: Reduces unnecessary exposure and aligns analytics with purpose limitation.
Application / Control: Never collect passwords, API keys, authentication secrets or payment credentials in analytics.
